items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: They had Nat Geraci. And Tony Giardino and myself.

ctx.x: And the party that people would... What kind of dancing did they do? Did they do the Charleston then or that was after the dance?

Yes. I think it was after Charleston. Black body and all that. Fuzz trot, waltzes and all the girls. I just wanted to get back over to the military band. It was the Italian band. It was every Sunday morning we used to go to rehearsals there. It was from about nine to twelve. Like we learned a lot. I used to have to drag Fuzzola out of bed then. And he used to make it with me. And sometime back there was a plane of March. I think it was Starling Strikes Forever. And Fuzzola was hitting some hot legs up in there.…
That's Willie? Yeah, that's Willie, yeah. And that's the mothers, huh? Well, let's see. Pinky died. That was the oldest brother.
